title: Slow growth vs Fast growth
subtitle: Kya farak hai jo 1K se 10K tak le jaata hai?

slides.b: Fast: Ek niche fix karo aur usi par 30 din consistent raho. Algorithm ko samajh aana chahiye ki aap kis cheez ke expert ho.
Fast: Carousel + Reels mix. Carousel save hota hai, Reel reach laati hai. Dono milke account grow karte hain.
Fast: Pehle 30 minute mein har comment ka reply. Engagement jitna jaldi, reach utni zyada.

slides.h: Slow: Bio mein kuch clear nahi
slides.b: Fast: Bio = Aap kaun ho + kya milega + ek link. 3 second mein samajh aana chahiye.

caption: Aap abhi kaunsi growth mein ho? Slow ya fast? Comment mein batao 👇

title: Pehla digital product kaise chunein?
subtitle: Bina guesswork ke, 4 simple steps

slides.b: Jo kaam aap dusron se better karte ho: Canva, Excel, editing, cooking, padhai. Wahi aapka product ban sakta hai.
Comments aur DMs padho. Jo sawaal baar baar aata hai, uska solution hi best product hai.
Ebook, template ya checklist. 1-2 din mein ban jaaye aisa product pehle launch karo.
Pehla product ₹99-₹299 mein rakho. Trust banega, reviews aayenge, phir bada product lao.

caption: Aapka pehla digital product kya hoga? Comment mein likho, main feedback dunga.

title: YouTube par views nahi aa rahe?
subtitle: Ye 4 galtiyan check karo

slides.b: 3-4 words max. Ek face, ek emotion, ek bada word. Mobile par chhota dikhta hai, simple rakho.
Log jo type karte hain wahi title mein daalo. YouTube search bar ka autocomplete use karo.
Pehle 10 second mein bata do video mein kya milega. 'Hello doston' ke baad seedha point.
Hafte mein 2 video, fix din aur time. Audience aur algorithm dono aapko expect karne lagte hain.

caption: Inme se kaunsi galti aap kar rahe the? Honest batao 😄

title: Bina ads ke product kaise bechein?
subtitle: Organic selling ka simple formula

slides.b: 10 post free value do, 1 post mein product bolo. Log tab kharidte hain jab aap par trust ho.
'Comment karo GUIDE' wali strategy use karo. Har comment ek lead hai, DM mein link bhejo.
Students ke screenshots, before-after, apni kamai ka proof. Social proof sabse bada salesman hai.
Feed par value, story par offer. Poll aur question sticker se interest check karo.

caption: Organic selling possible hai, bas system chahiye. Save kar lo ye post 🔖

title: Content ideas khatam ho gaye?
subtitle: Ye 4 jagah se kabhi khatam nahi honge

slides.b: Har sawaal ek naya post hai. Ek sawaal = ek carousel = ek reel.
Copy nahi, improve karo. Unke viral topic par apna angle aur apna example do.
Aapne kya seekha, kya galti ki, pehli kamai kaise hui. Personal stories sabse zyada connect karti hain.
Ek idea ko carousel, reel, story, YouTube short aur Facebook post mein badlo. Kaam ek, content paanch.

caption: Is post ko save karo, next time idea khatam ho to yahan aana 💡

title: Reel par 1000 views bhi nahi?
subtitle: Hook ka khel samjho

slides.b: Screen par bada text + movement. Agar pehle second mein scroll ruka nahi, reel khatam.
'Aapke reels par views nahi aa rahe?' Viewer ko lage ye mere baare mein baat ho rahi hai.
Trending audio low volume par rakho, voice-over upar. Reach bhi, value bhi.
Reel ka end aise karo ki start se jud jaaye. Log dobara dekhenge, watch time badhega.

caption: Next reel mein ye 4 cheezein try karo aur result batao 🎬

title: Canva se ₹0 mein product banao
subtitle: Ye 4 products aaj hi bana sakte ho

slides.b: Coaches aur small businesses ko ready templates chahiye. 30 templates ka pack = ek product.
Study planner, budget tracker, habit tracker. PDF banao aur bech do.
Freshers ke liye professional resume templates. Har season demand rehti hai.
Apni skill par 20-30 page ki guide. Canva ke ebook templates se 1 din mein ready.

caption: Canva free hai, idea aapka hai. Kaunsa product banaoge? 👇

title: Facebook page abhi bhi kaam karta hai
subtitle: Bas tareeka badal gaya hai

slides.h: Reels ko Facebook par bhi daalo
slides.b: Facebook reels ki reach abhi bhi bahut achhi hai. Instagram se cross-post on karo.
Apne niche ke groups join karo, sawaalon ke jawab do. Log khud page par aayenge.
Profile par professional mode se followers aur monetization dono khulte hain.
Facebook audience routine pasand karti hai. Roz same time par post karo.

caption: Facebook ko ignore mat karo, wahan bhi aapke customers hain 💙

title: Pehli sale kyun nahi ho rahi?
subtitle: Problem product mein nahi, ye ho sakti hai

slides.b: Ek post mein bataya aur bhool gaye? Product ke baare mein kam se kam 10 baar alag tarah se bolo.
Free value, live sessions aur personal stories se trust banta hai. Trust ke bina sale nahi.
Kya milega, kisko milega, kitne ka hai, kaise milega. 4 cheezein ek line mein clear karo.
Zyada tar log 30 din mein chhod dete hain. Jo 90 din tikta hai, wahi kamaata hai.

caption: Pehli sale sabse mushkil hoti hai, baad mein system chalta hai. Lage raho 💪

title: YouTube Shorts se subscribers kaise?
subtitle: Shorts ko long video se jodo

slides.b: 30-45 second, sirf ek tip. Zyada cheezein ek short mein daaloge to log scroll kar denge.
Har short ke neeche related long video link karo. Shorts viewer subscriber ban jaata hai.
'Part 1, Part 2' wale shorts. Log agla part dekhne ke liye subscribe karte hain.
Shorts ka algorithm consistency pasand karta hai. 30 din, 30 shorts ka challenge lo.

caption: 30 din ka shorts challenge kaun lega? Comment karo 'I'M IN' 🔥

title: Bio jo followers ko customer banaye
subtitle: 4 line ka magic formula

slides.b: 'Digital product coach' ya 'YouTube growth mentor'. Simple aur clear.
'Beginners ko online kamana sikhata hoon'. Audience khud ko pehchane.
'500+ students' ya '10K+ creators helped'. Number trust banata hai.
'Free guide neeche 👇' aur ek link. Bio ka kaam hai click karwana.

caption: Abhi apni bio check karo. Kitni lines match hui? 🤔

title: Product ka price kaise decide karein?
subtitle: Na zyada sasta, na zyada mehenga

slides.b: Aapka product kitna time ya paisa bachata hai? Price uska 10-20% rakho.
Naye logon ke liye chhota product. Trust banane ka sabse aasaan tareeka.
Course ya bundle. Yahin se asli kamai hoti hai.
3 products ek saath thode discount par. Average order value badh jaati hai.

caption: Aap apne product ka price kitna rakhte ho? Comment mein batao 💰

title: Carousel jo log save karte hain
subtitle: Save = reach. Ye formats try karo

slides.b: 'Post karne se pehle ye 5 cheezein check karo'. Log save karte hain baad mein use karne ke liye.
Galat tareeka vs sahi tareeka. Comparison wale carousel sabse zyada share hote hain.
Ek kaam ko 5-7 steps mein tod do. Har slide par ek step.
'Free tools jo har creator ko pata hone chahiye'. Resource lists hamesha save hoti hain.

caption: Ye post bhi save kar lo, next carousel banate waqt kaam aayega 🔖

title: Comment se DM, DM se sale
subtitle: Keyword strategy kaise kaam karti hai

slides.b: Free guide, checklist ya mini video. Jo aapke paid product se juda ho.
'Comment karo GUIDE aur main DM mein bhejunga'. Comments badhenge, reach badhegi.
Sirf link mat bhejo. Ek sawaal poochho: 'Aap abhi kya karte ho?' Baat se rishta banta hai.
2-3 din baad paid product ka offer bhejo. Jo free se khush hai, wahi kharidega.

caption: Ye strategy test karna hai? Comment karo 'DM' 😉

title: Consistency kaise banaye rakhein?
subtitle: Motivation se nahi, system se

slides.b: Hafte mein ek din 7 post bana lo. Roz sochna nahi padega.
Har din ka topic pehle se fix: Monday tips, Wednesday story, Friday product.
80% achha post jo publish hua, 100% perfect post se better hai jo draft mein pada hai.
Scheduling tools se post pehle se schedule kar do. Aap busy ho, account active rahe.

caption: Aap hafte mein kitne din post karte ho? Sach batao 😅

title: Thumbnail jo click karwaye
subtitle: CTR badhane ke 4 rules

slides.b: Surprise, khushi ya confusion. Insaan chehre ko pehle notice karta hai.
Yellow, red, blue background. YouTube ke white aur black UI mein alag dikho.
Thumbnail aur title milke kahani batayein. Dono mein same words waste hain.
Thumbnail ko chhota karke dekho. Phone par samajh aaye tabhi upload karo.

caption: Apna latest thumbnail in rules par check karo 👀

title: Product kahan se bechein?
subtitle: Beginners ke liye aasaan platforms

slides.b: Ek simple page aur UPI/Razorpay payment link. Shuru karne ke liye itna kaafi hai.
Course aur digital downloads ke liye ready platforms. Delivery automatic ho jaati hai.
Chhote level par DM mein payment aur WhatsApp par delivery bhi chal jaata hai.
Payment ke baad file automatic email ho jaaye. Aap so rahe ho, sale ho rahi hai.

caption: Aap abhi kahan se bechte ho? Comment mein platform ka naam likho 👇

title: Hashtag abhi bhi kaam karte hain?
subtitle: Haan, lekin sahi tareeke se

slides.b: 30 hashtag ka zamana gaya. Kam aur relevant hashtag use karo.
#digitalproducts jaise specific tags. Bahut bade tags mein post kho jaati hai.
Instagram ab caption ke words se bhi search karta hai. Topic ke keywords likho.
Advanced settings mein alt text. Instagram ko samajh aata hai post kis baare mein hai.

caption: Aap kitne hashtag use karte ho? 🤔

title: Camera se dar lagta hai?
subtitle: Bina face dikhaye content banao

slides.b: Sirf text aur design. Face ki zaroorat hi nahi. Jaise ye post!
Tutorials, app reviews, tips. Aawaz aur screen kaafi hai.
Likhte hue, banate hue, unbox karte hue haath. Bahut log aise hi grow karte hain.
Stock video ya B-roll par apni aawaz. Personality aawaz se bhi aati hai.

caption: Faceless content se bhi brand banta hai. Aap kaunsa try karoge? 🎙️

title: Instagram Story se sale kaise?
subtitle: Roz ki 5 story ka formula

slides.b: Aaj kya kar rahe ho. Personal connection banta hai.
Ek quick tip ya mistake. Log rukte hain aur seekhte hain.
Student ka message, review ya result ka screenshot.
Link sticker ke saath product. Value ke baad offer natural lagta hai.

caption: Kal se ye 5 story formula try karo aur mujhe tag karo 📲

title: Followers kam hain? Koi baat nahi
subtitle: Chhote account bhi kamaate hain

slides.b: 1000 log jo aap par bharosa karte hain, ek saal mein lakhs ki sale de sakte hain.
500 followers jo comment karte hain, 50K silent followers se better hain.
Chhote niche mein expert bano. Competition kam, trust zyada.
Chhote account ka fayda: aap har kisi ko reply kar sakte ho. Ye bade account nahi kar paate.

caption: Aapke abhi kitne followers hain? Number se mat daro 💪

title: Pehli video kaise banayein?
subtitle: Beginner checklist

slides.b: Naya camera mat kharido. Phone, khidki ki roshni aur ek sasta mic.
Hook (kya milega), content (3-5 points), ending (subscribe + next video).
Cuts, captions aur background music. Fancy effects ki zaroorat nahi.
Pehli video ke views ka mat socho. 10 video ke baad hi asli seekh milti hai.

caption: Pehli video upload kar di? Link comment mein daalo, main dekhunga 🎥

title: Product launch checklist
subtitle: Launch se 7 din pehle ye karo

slides.b: 'Kuch naya aa raha hai' wale posts. Curiosity banao.
'Comment karo YES, launch par pehle aapko bataunga'. Ready buyers ki list.
Pehle 48 ghante discount. Urgency se log jaldi decide karte hain.
Instagram ya YouTube live par product dikhao aur sawaalon ke jawab do.

caption: Ye checklist save karo, launch ke time kaam aayegi 🚀

title: Kab post karna chahiye?
subtitle: Best time ka asli jawab

slides.b: Professional dashboard mein 'Most active times'. Aapki audience ka time wahi hai.
Post ko thoda time do pehle engagement lene ka, phir peak time mein push milta hai.
Perfect time se zyada important hai roz same time par post karna.
2 hafte alag time try karo aur reach compare karo. Data se decide karo.

caption: Aap kis time post karte ho? ⏰

title: Testimonial kaise lein?
subtitle: Social proof ka system

slides.b: Product ke 3-5 din baad: 'Aapko kaisa laga? 2 line mein bata sakte ho?'
Achha message aaye to poochh lo: 'Kya main ise share kar sakta hoon?'
'Kitne followers badhe? Pehli sale kab hui?' Numbers wala review zyada kaam karta hai.
Saare reviews ek story highlight mein. Naya visitor turant trust karega.

caption: Aapke paas kitne testimonials hain? Aaj se collect karna shuru karo 📸

title: Ek hafte ka content plan
subtitle: Copy karo aur use karo

slides.b: Apne niche ki 2 practical tips. Carousel ya short reel.
Apni journey ka ek kissa. Galti, seekh ya pehli kamai.
Student result aur sabse common sawaal ka jawab.
Product ka soft offer aur ek halka-phulka trending reel.

caption: Is plan ko screenshot karo aur kal se shuru karo 📅

title: Comparison band karo
subtitle: Dusre ka chapter 20 vs aapka chapter 1

slides.h: Unhone bhi zero se shuru kiya
slides.b: Jo aaj 1 million par hai, wo bhi kabhi 0 followers par tha.
Sirf ek comparison theek hai: pichhle mahine ke aap vs aaj ke aap.
Bade creators se strategy seekho, unke numbers se khud ko chhota mat samjho.
Slow progress bhi progress hai. Rukna mat, bas.

caption: Ye post kisi aise dost ko bhejo jise aaj iski zaroorat hai ❤️

title: YouTube SEO simple bhasha mein
subtitle: Search mein upar kaise aayein

slides.b: 'Instagram growth tips' jaise words title ke pehle hisse mein.
Video kis baare mein hai, keywords ke saath. Plus timestamps.
YouTube aapki aawaz bhi samajhta hai. Keyword pehle 30 second mein bolo.
Ek topic ki saari videos ek playlist mein. Watch time aur ranking dono badhte hain.

caption: SEO se ek video saalon tak views laati hai. Save karo 🔍

title: Ek product, 4 tarah ki kamai
subtitle: Product ko maximum use karo

slides.b: Apne page se product bechna. Basic aur sabse pehla tareeka.
Dusre creators aapka product bechein aur commission lein. Aapki reach badh jaati hai.
Product ke saath ek bonus ya advanced version offer karo.
Usi topic par paid live session. Product ka content, naya format.

caption: Aap kitne tareekon se kamaate ho? Comment karo 💸

title: Facebook par reach kaise badhayein?
subtitle: 2026 mein jo kaam kar raha hai

slides.b: Facebook bhi short video ko sabse zyada push karta hai.
'Aap kya choose karoge, A ya B?' Comment wale posts zyada logon tak jaate hain.
Post mein bahar ka link reach kam kar sakta hai. Link pehle comment mein daalo.
Page ke saath ek community group. Wahan ki engagement page tak laati hai.

caption: Facebook par aapki sabse achhi post kaunsi rahi? 👇

title: Collab post ka power
subtitle: Dusre ki audience tak free mein pahuncho

slides.b: Apne jaise followers wale creators ke saath collab aasaan hota hai.
'Hum dono milke ek guide banate hain'. Dono ki audience ko fayda ho.
Post ek, do accounts par dikhegi. Likes aur comments dono jagah gine jaate hain.
Ek collab ke baad bhi baat karte raho. Lambe collabs zyada growth dete hain.

caption: Kisi ke saath collab karna chahte ho? Comment mein apna niche likho 🤝

title: Customer ke sawaal = sale ka mauka
subtitle: Objections ko kaise handle karein

slides.b: Value dikhao: 'Ye ek baar ka kharcha hai, roz kaam aayega'. Chhota version bhi offer karo.
Beginner students ke results dikhao. 'Inhone bhi zero se shuru kiya tha'.
Limited time bonus ya price badhne ki date batao. Sach mein, bina jhooth ke.
Refund policy ya free sample do. Risk kam lagega to decision aasaan.

caption: Aapse customer sabse zyada kya poochhte hain? 👇

title: Viral hone ka secret nahi hai
subtitle: Lekin ye 4 cheezein chance badhati hain

slides.b: Jo baat har kisi ke saath hoti hai. Log share karte hain: 'Ye to main hoon!'
Jo turant kaam aaye. Save aur share dono milte hain.
Khushi, motivation ya hasi. Emotion wala content aage badhta hai.
Ek post, ek message. Jitna simple, utna shareable.

caption: Aapka sabse viral post kaunsa tha aur kyun? 🔥

title: Online kamai ke 4 myths
subtitle: Inpe bharosa band karo

slides.b: Sach: 6-12 mahine ki mehnat ke baad steady income aati hai.
Sach: 1000 engaged followers se bhi achhi kamai ho sakti hai.
Sach: Phone, internet aur seekhne ki ichha. Bas.

slides.h: 'Sab kar rahe hain, late ho gaya'
slides.b: Sach: Internet roz naye logon se bhar raha hai. Aapki audience abhi bhi aapka wait kar rahi hai.

caption: Aap kis myth par bharosa karte the? Honest raho 😄

subtitle: 2 din ka action plan

slides.b: Audience ka ek problem chuno aur product ka outline likho.
Ebook ya template ka content Canva mein banao.
Simple landing page aur payment link set karo.
Story aur post mein announce karo. Pehli sale ka wait shuru!
